records.subject: In–Te bonds in liquid In2As2Te3
records.quote: X-ray diffraction measurements for liquid In2As2Te3 were carried out to investigate the bonding nature between In and Te atoms.
context_quotes: The distribution function obtained by the diffraction measurement suggests that the In-Te bonds are comparatively covalent, by contrast with the ionic Tl-Te bonds.
